projectVerifications.description:
Evolexx – E-Commerce Platform (Client Project)
A full-stack e-commerce site built for a real-world client, featuring separate Admin Dashboard and Customer Portal.
• Frontend: React.js, Tailwind CSS, Context API for state management, Chart.js for analytics.
• Backend: Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, JWT authentication, Multer & Cloudinary for media management,
Nodemailer for email notifications.
• Developed role-based authentication with secure login and admin controls.
• Implemented product, order, and user management with real-time updates.
• Designed responsive UI for seamless customer experience and efficient admin operations.
GitHub repo link: Evolexx.lk
Website link: Evolexx.lk
Full-stack CRUD for Delivery Management System for Kandurata Hardware
A delivery management solution as part of an online hardware system using the MERN stack (MongoDB, ExpessJS,
ReactJS, NodeJS)
• Designed and implemented a Delivery Management System to streamline driver management and order delivery
processes.
• Developed features to add, edit, and delete drivers, assign drivers to orders, and track delivery details in real time.
• Built a user-friendly dashboard for logistics managers to manage deliveries efficiently and monitor order statuses.
GitHub repo link: KandurataHardware
Online Banking System
A secure and user-friendly web application developed to streamline banking operations and enhance account
management.
• Implemented Login and Account Creation functionality, ensuring secure authentication and user registration.
• Developed a Forgot Password feature with a password option key that triggers an OTP sent directly to the user’s
email in real time for secure password recovery.
• Built an Admin Dashboard to enable administrators to view and manage all user accounts effectively
GitHub repo link: OnlineBanking
Skill Hub – Learning Progress Tracker
A full-stack application to help users track their learning progress using Spring Boot and React.
• Developed a responsive web app using React for the frontend and Spring Boot for the backend.
• Implemented MongoDB as the NoSQL database to store user data, learning plans, and progress.
• Created RESTful APIs to support CRUD operations, user filtering by plan ID and user ID.
• Included features for adding learning plans, marking progress, and managing session-based login.
• Integrated both manual login and Google OAuth2 authentication using JWT tokens for secure access.
GitHub repo link: SkillHub
To-Do Memo (Mobile Application)
A task management app built with Android Studio and Kotlin, featuring customizable to-do lists, reminders, timers,
notifications, and a home screen widget for quick task access.
GitHub repo link: NotesSQLite
Full-stack web application FurniHeaven – AI-Powered Online Furniture Store
E-commerce platform for discovering and purchasing furniture, with integrated AI capabilities to generate furniture ideas
based on user requirements.
• Developed using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React + Vite, Node.js) with a responsive and modern UI.
• Built both admin and customer interfaces with JWT authentication for secure access control.
• Admin features include adding/editing/deleting products, managing orders (approve/deny), and tracking
inventory.
• Integrated an AI-based recommendation tool that dynamically generates furniture suggestions based on users’
preferences and room requirements.
GitHub repo link: Furni_Heaven
